sections.body: Read the assigned source section, write a 5–7 point closed-book summary, then explain one cause–effect relationship or compare two relevant concepts. Build a reusable writing skill for transitions and coherence and apply it to a timed outline or paragraph.

sections.body: Connect the concept to the official syllabus wording. Attempt a verified past question only after locating it in the official paper; record year, paper, question number and the exact demand in your error log.

Connect the topic to one adjacent syllabus heading.
Record one confusion and resolve it from the source.

activities.title: Recall & explain
activities.prompt: Without notes, explain Transitions and coherence. Include the central concepts, one distinction or causal link, and one UPSC-relevant application.
activities.hint: Use a definition, 3–5 key points, one example, and a concise concluding link to the syllabus.
activities.answer: A satisfactory response defines Transitions and coherence, explains its main dimensions, makes at least one accurate distinction or causal link, and connects it to the relevant UPSC syllabus. Compare your response with the assigned source and correct gaps.
activities.explanation: Self-check factual accuracy, conceptual clarity, coverage of the question demand and use of a relevant example. This is a retrieval activity, not an official UPSC question.
